Obvious influences from the jukebox musicals “Moulin Rouge,” “Six,” “Head Over Heels,” and the more recent “Once Upon a One More Time” (using the music of Britney Spears) and the hilarity of “Something Rotten” are on display.
Bookwriter David West Read, an Emmy winner for "Schitt's Creek," blended these two disparate properties into a soft-serve-sweet-swirl of a musical forged in the #girlboss era.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this Max Martin jukebox musical, with many praising its energetic performances, sharp humor, and empowerment themes, while others find it overstuffed and superficial despite crowd-pleasing pop hits.
